name: Amöneburg (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red and white, charged at the top with the city arms of Amöneburg (Saint Martin on horseback with the Mainz wheel and a letter A on white).
history: The city arms were approved by the Hessian Minister of the Interior on 8 December 1978; the flag was approved by the same ministry on 18 July 1979.

features.role: Amöneburg arms — Saint Martin with wheel and letter A
